# Preciosura

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store for perfumes (Arabic, designer, niche), makeup, hair and body care, and mate items. Ships nationwide by DAC and offers pickup at two Montevideo points; orders are made to order in about 3 to 7 business days.
